bag_wtp_edit_fits_rural_7 = {
	var:bag_wtp_prm7 > 0
	bag_wtp_is_granary = no
	bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
	NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit } }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm7 = 284
			}
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fruit_orchard } }
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_prm7 = 285
				var:bag_wtp_prm7 = 286
			}
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_irq_nakhil_grove } }
		}
	}
}

	var:bag_wtp_vw1 > 0
	bag_wtp_is_granary = no
	bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
	NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fishing_village } }
	OR = {
		AND = {
			var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 6
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fish } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 39
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:naval_supplies } }
		}
		AND = {
			var:bag_wtp_vw1 = 42
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:pottery } }
		}
	}
}
